refutations.title: 2012 / 2018 transition diagnostics
refutations.hypothesis_tested: Compare complete three-year windows before and after each transition.
refutations.evidence: 2012 raw change not available%; harmonized change not available%; change reduction not available%. This descriptive comparison cannot separate sensor and physical change. See both transition audits.

refutations.title: Cell occupancy and timestamp windows
refutations.hypothesis_tested: Avoid raising occupancy for repeated rows, subpixels, and coincident satellites.
refutations.evidence: 13854 selected rows form 11828 cell windows. Sources are averaged within each family in anchored 60-minute windows; morning and afternoon passes remain separate. Missing times retain date-only source groups. This is a heuristic, not event ground truth.

refutations.title: Target grid and footprint limitations
refutations.hypothesis_tested: Prevent raw subpixel density from being interpreted as burning extent.
refutations.evidence: Occupancy uses a 1,000 m sinusoidal target grid, distinct from the native MODIS tile grid. Scan/track metadata are retained. No polygon footprint intersection, bow-tie correction, or burned-area estimate is claimed.

refutations.title: Supplied source types and persistence flags
refutations.hypothesis_tested: Separate vegetation-type records from supplied volcanic, other static-land, and offshore source types.
refutations.evidence: 82 rows have supplied non-vegetation types (0.6%). Guard enabled: True. Persistence-only flags are retained without establishing an industrial cause or automatically excluding vegetation records.
